Hi Helen — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (infra logs) and Monica (compliance handoff).

Immediate answers at a high level:
- What we log: operator/admin actions across the control plane and Private agents: user_id, actor_email, action (e.g., ROLE_CHANGE, MODEL_DEPLOY, API_KEY_CREATE, EXPORT_RUN), resource_id, resource_type, timestamp (UTC), client_ip, user_agent, request_id, request_payload_snippet (redacted), response_code, region, model_id, token_counts. I attached a sample CSV schema.
- Retention: default 13 months for admin activity; 0- to 90-day soft-delete window before immutable cold-snapshot (customer can request longer retention under contract).
- Export options: ad-hoc snapshot (immutable NDJSON / Parquet) or streaming (Kafka/SQS). We can produce a signed, timestamped S3 bundle and provide an MD5/SHA256 manifest.
- Sampling: we can produce a stratified sample (1% or custom) or provide a full export for a bounded date range. For attestations we recommend full exports for the requested period; sampling is acceptable for control design reviews.
- Integrity: snapshots are write-once in S3 with versioning; we generate a SHA256 manifest per object and record the manifest in our chain-of-custody log (signed with our KMS key).

Ben — can you attach the export run commands and the one-page playbook for the auditor? Monica will coordinate delivery and legal approvals for the presigned link.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: SIG / SOC2 evidence request: admin activity extracts and sampling plan

Thanks — adding the technical detail Helen asked for. Below are concrete export options and commands.

1) Logged fields (exact):
- timestamp_utc, actor_id, actor_email, action_type, resource_id, resource_type, request_id, request_payload_hash, response_status, client_ip, user_agent, region, model_variant, token_count, trace_id

2) Retention / immutability:
- Hot table retention: 90 days mutable for operational needs.
- Cold snapshots: monthly immutable snapshots retained 13 months by default.
- Snapshots stored in private S3 bucket with object-lock (governance mode) and bucket versioning enabled. KMS-encrypted.

3) Export formats & recommended use:
- NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON) with one event per line — best for audit tooling.
- Parquet for analytics (compressed, columnar).
- CSV for quick inspector review (we include quoted JSON in payload columns).

4) Sampling approach:
- We support random stratified sampling by actor_email and by day. Typical default: 1% overall or configurable 0.1%-5%.
- For evidentiary audits we recommend full export for the exact date range (we can scope to business hours or UTC windows).

5) Delivery options:
- Secure S3 bundle (preferred): we create a presigned, single-use URL valid 7 days and provide a SHA256 manifest.
- Secure portal upload to sec-requests@acmehealth.com (per your note).
- Direct transfer to customer SFTP (customer-managed endpoint) with s3sync.

6) Integrity & chain-of-custody:
- Each snapshot object is hashed with SHA256; we produce a manifest.json with object paths, hashes, and a signed metadata record (KMS key id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01).
- All export operations are logged with an export_id and signed by the operator account; the export_id lives in the audit trail.

Example command (internal):
# create immutable ndjson snapshot for 2026-06-01..2026-06-30
./export_tool --start 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z --end 2026-06-30T23:59:59Z --format ndjson --output s3://redwood-audit-bundles/acme/2026-06-admin-activity.ndjson --object-lock --kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01

Attachment: export-run-commands.sh (script with wrapper for export_tool + manifest generation)

Naomi / Monica: If we produce a full export for 2026-06-01..06-30, I can stage the S3 bundle and provide the presigned link within 24 hours of approval. If they prefer a 1% stratified sample instead, indicate the stratification key(s) and sampling rate.

— Ben
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
